title: bro-skill
brief: A one-file Agent Skills-format skill adding a `/bro` command: when a coding agent's last reply was too dense or jargon-heavy, `/bro` re-explains that same answer in plain language, with facts, paths, and commands preserved verbatim. It ships an installer covering Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and opencode; MIT-licensed.
details: bro-skill is a one-file Agent Skills-format skill that adds a /bro slash command to coding agents. When the assistant's last reply was too dense, jargon-heavy, or formal, typing /bro re-explains that same previous message in plain language, with baked-in rules: re-explain never re-answer, facts, paths, commands, and numbers survive verbatim, and the reply matches the user's language. It ships an installer covering Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and opencode; MIT-licensed.
